    public function recordPayment(Request $request)
    {
        try {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'invoice_id' => 'required|integer',
                'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:1',
                'payment_mode' => 'required|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
                'idempotency_key' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            ]);

            // Use transaction with row locking to prevent concurrent payments
            $result = \DB::transaction(function () use ($validated) {
                // Lock the invoice row for update to prevent concurrent modifications
                $invoice = Invoice::where('id', $validated['invoice_id'])
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->first();
                
                if (!$invoice) {
                    return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invoice not found', 'status' => 404];
                }

                // Check if invoice is already paid or cancelled
                if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Paid' || $invoice->payment_status === 'Cancelled') {
                    return [
                        'success' => false, 
                        'message' => 'Cannot record payment on ' . strtolower($invoice->payment_status) . ' invoice',
                        'status' => 400
                    ];
                }

                // Calculate maximum allowed payment (prevent overpayment)
                $maxAllowed = $invoice->balance_due;
                
                // Validate amount doesn't exceed balance due
                if ($validated['amount'] > $maxAllowed) {
                    return [
                        'success' => false, 
                        'message' => 'Payment amount (₹' . $validated['amount'] . ') exceeds balance due (₹' . $maxAllowed . '). Maximum allowed: ₹' . $maxAllowed,
                        'status' => 400
                    ];
                }

                // Idempotency check - prevent duplicate payments
                if (!empty($validated['idempotency_key'])) {
                    $existingPayment = \DB::table('payment_records')
                        ->where('idempotency_key', $validated['idempotency_key'])
                        ->first();
                    if ($existingPayment) {
                        return [
                            'success' => true,
                            'message' => 'Payment already recorded (idempotent response)',
                            'duplicate' => true,
                            'invoice' => $invoice,
                            'status' => 200
                        ];
                    }
                }

                $newAmountReceived = $invoice->amount_received + $validated['amount'];
                $newBalanceDue = $invoice->grand_total - $newAmountReceived;

                $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
                if ($newBalanceDue <= 0) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Paid';
                    $newBalanceDue = 0;
                } elseif ($newAmountReceived > 0) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
                }

                $invoice->update([
                    'amount_received' => $newAmountReceived,
                    'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                    'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                    'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
                ]);

                // Record payment with idempotency key
                if (!empty($validated['idempotency_key'])) {
                    \DB::table('payment_records')->insert([
                        'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                        'amount' => $validated['amount'],
                        'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
                        'idempotency_key' => $validated['idempotency_key'],
                        'created_at' => now(),
                        'updated_at' => now(),
                    ]);
                }

                // Post accounting transaction for the payment
                try {
                    AccountingService::postInvoicePayment($invoice, $validated['amount'], $validated['payment_mode']);
                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                    \Log::error('Payment accounting error: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }

                // Update customer outstanding after payment
                CustomerLedgerService::updateCustomerOutstanding($invoice->customer_mobile);

                return [
                    'success' => true,
                    'message' => 'Payment recorded successfully',
                    'invoice' => $invoice,
                    'status' => 200
                ];
            });

            // Handle transaction result
            if (isset($result['status'])) {
                $statusCode = $result['status'];
                unset($result['status']);
                if (isset($result['invoice'])) {
                    $result['data'] = new InvoiceResource($result['invoice']->load('items'));
                    unset($result['invoice']);
                }
                return response()->json($result, $statusCode);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => $result['success'],
                'message' => $result['message'],
                'data' => new InvoiceResource($result['invoice']->load('items')),
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    public function recordMultiPayment(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'payments' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'payments.*.invoice_id' => 'required|exists:invoices,id',
            'payments.*.amount' => 'required|numeric|min:1',
            'payment_mode' => 'required|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
        ]);

        $results = [];

        foreach ($validated['payments'] as $payment) {
            $invoice = Invoice::findOrFail($payment['invoice_id']);

            $newAmountReceived = $invoice->amount_received + $payment['amount'];
            $newBalanceDue = $invoice->grand_total - $newAmountReceived;

            $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
            if ($newBalanceDue <= 0) {
                $paymentStatus = 'Paid';
                $newBalanceDue = 0;
            } elseif ($newAmountReceived > 0) {
                $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
            }

            $invoice->update([
                'amount_received' => $newAmountReceived,
                'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
            ]);

            $results[] = new InvoiceResource($invoice->load('items'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Payments recorded successfully',
            'data' => $results,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Process a refund on an invoice
     */
    public function refund(Request $request, Invoice $invoice)
    {
        try {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01',
                'reason' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
                'payment_mode' => 'nullable|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
            ]);

            // Check if invoice is paid or partially paid
            if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Pending') {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Cannot refund - invoice has no payments'
                ], 400);
            }

            if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Cancelled') {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Cannot refund - invoice is cancelled'
                ], 400);
            }

            // Maximum refund is the amount received
            $maxRefund = $invoice->amount_received;
            
            if ($validated['amount'] > $maxRefund) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => "Refund amount (₹{$validated['amount']}) exceeds amount received (₹{$maxRefund}). Maximum refund: ₹{$maxRefund}"
                ], 400);
            }

            // Process refund within transaction
            $result = \DB::transaction(function () use ($invoice, $validated) {
                // Lock invoice for update
                $lockedInvoice = Invoice::where('id', $invoice->id)
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->first();

                // Recalculate after lock
                $newAmountReceived = $lockedInvoice->amount_received - $validated['amount'];
                $newBalanceDue = $lockedInvoice->grand_total - $newAmountReceived;

                // Determine new payment status
                $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
                if ($newAmountReceived <= 0) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
                    $newAmountReceived = 0;
                    $newBalanceDue = $lockedInvoice->grand_total;
                } elseif ($newBalanceDue < $lockedInvoice->grand_total) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
                }

                // Update invoice
                $lockedInvoice->update([
                    'amount_received' => $newAmountReceived,
                    'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                    'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                ]);

                // Record refund in payment_records table
                \DB::table('payment_records')->insert([
                    'invoice_id' => $lockedInvoice->id,
                    'amount' => -$validated['amount'], // Negative for refund
                    'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'] ?? 'Cash',
                    'idempotency_key' => 'refund-' . uniqid(),
                    'reference_number' => 'REF-' . date('Ymd') . '-' . rand(1000, 9999),
                    'notes' => $validated['reason'] ?? 'Refund processed',
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ]);

                return [
                    'invoice' => $lockedInvoice,
                    'refund_amount' => $validated['amount'],
                    'new_status' => $paymentStatus,
                ];
            });

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Refund processed successfully',
                'data' => [
                    'invoice' => new InvoiceResource($result['invoice']->load('items')),
                    'refund_amount' => $result['refund_amount'],
                    'previous_received' => $result['invoice']->amount_received + $result['refund_amount'],
                    'new_received' => $result['invoice']->amount_received,
                    'new_balance_due' => $result['invoice']->balance_due,
                    'payment_status' => $result['new_status'],
                ]
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

            ], 201);

    public function update(Request $request, Order $order): JsonResponse

            'customer_id' => 'nullable|exists:users,id',
            'customer_name' => 'sometimes|string|max:255',
            'customer_mobile' => 'nullable|string|max:20',
            'type' => 'sometimes|in:layaway,preorder,booking',
            'order_date' => 'sometimes|date',
            'expiry_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string',
            'status' => 'sometimes|in:pending,partial_payment,fulfilled,cancelled,expired',
            'items' => 'sometimes|array|min:1',
            'items.*.product_id' => 'required_with:items|exists:products,id',
            'items.*.variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'items.*.product_name' => 'required_with:items|string',
            'items.*.sku' => 'nullable|string',
            'items.*.quantity' => 'required_with:items|numeric|min:0.001',
            'items.*.unit_price' => 'required_with:items|numeric|min:0',
            'items.*.discount' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'items.*.tax_rate' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:100',
        ]);

        $oldItems = $order->items->keyBy('product_id');

        StockReservation::releaseStock($order);

        $order->update(array_diff_key($validated, array_flip(['items'])));

            $subtotal = 0;
            $taxAmount = 0;

                $price = $itemData['unit_price'];

                $itemTax = $itemSubtotal * ($taxRate / 100);
                $itemTotal = $itemSubtotal + $itemTax;

                    'order_id' => $order->id,
                    'product_id' => $itemData['product_id'],
                    'variant_id' => $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null,
                    'product_name' => $itemData['product_name'],

    public function addPayment(Request $request, Order $order): JsonResponse
    {

        $validated = $request->validate([

        ]);

        $validated['created_by'] = auth()->id();

        $order->recalculate();
        $order->save();

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Payment added successfully',
            'order' => $order->load(['items', 'customer', 'payments'])
        ]);
    }

    public function cancel(Request $request, Order $order): JsonResponse
    {
        if ($order->status === 'fulfilled') {

        }

        $releaseResult = StockReservation::releaseStock($order);

        $order->update(['status' => 'cancelled']);

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Order cancelled successfully',
            'order' => $order->fresh()->load(['items']),
            'stock_released' => $releaseResult['released']
        ]);
    }

    public function fulfill(Order $order): JsonResponse
    {
        if ($order->status === 'fulfilled') {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Order already fulfilled'], 400);
        }

        if ($order->status === 'cancelled') {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Cannot fulfil cancelled orders'], 400);
        }

        $fulfillResult = StockReservation::fulfillStock($order);

        $invoice = $order->generateInvoice();

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Order fulfilled and invoice created',
            'order' => $order->fresh()->load(['items', 'payments']),
            'invoice' => $invoice->load('items'),
            'stock_consumed' => $fulfillResult['fulfilled']
        ], 201);
    }

    public function extendExpiry(Request $request, Order $order): JsonResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'expiry_date' => 'required|date|after:today',
        ]);

        $order->update(['expiry_date' => $validated['expiry_date']]);

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Expiry date extended',
            'order' => $order->fresh()
        ]);
    }

                    if ($warehouseStock) {

                $product->update([

                ]);
            }
        }

            $availableCredit = $supplier->available_credit ?? ($creditAdded - $creditUsed);
            
            $adjustedOutstanding = $totalBalanceDue - $availableCredit;
            
            if ($totalBalanceDue > 0 || $availableCredit > 0) {
                $result[] = [
                    'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                    'supplier' => $supplier,
                    'po_count' => $supplier->purchaseOrders->count(),
                    'total_amount' => $totalAmount,
                    'total_paid' => $totalPaid,
                    'total_returns' => $totalReturns,
                    'total_balance_due' => $totalBalanceDue,
                    'available_credit' => $availableCredit,
                    'adjusted_outstanding' => max(0, $adjustedOutstanding),
                ];
            }
        }

        usort($result, fn($a, $b) => $b['adjusted_outstanding'] <=> $a['adjusted_outstanding']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $result
        ]);
    }

    public function destroy(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        // ERP RULE: PO can be deleted only if no stock has been received
        if (!$purchaseOrder->canBeDeleted()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => "Cannot delete purchase order because {$purchaseOrder->received_quantity} units have already been received. Please cancel the receipts first.",
            ], 422);
        }

        // Delete purchase order items first (due to foreign key constraints)
        $purchaseOrder->items()->delete();
        
        // Delete the purchase order
        $purchaseOrder->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Purchase order deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    private function updateStockFromPO(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        $costingEngine = app(\App\Services\CostingEngine::class);
        
        foreach ($purchaseOrder->items as $item) {
            $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
            $newQty = (float) $item->quantity;
            $newCost = (float) $item->unit_cost;
            $variantId = $item->variant_id;
            
            if ($product) {
                if ($variantId) {
                    $variant = ProductVariant::find($variantId);
                    if ($variant) {
                        $variant->current_stock += $newQty;
                        $variant->purchase_price = $newCost;
                        $variant->save();
                        
                        $warehouseStock = WarehouseStock::where('product_id', $product->id)
                            ->where('variant_id', $variantId)
                            ->first();
                        
                        if ($warehouseStock) {
                            $currentQty = (float) $warehouseStock->quantity;
                            $currentCost = (float) $warehouseStock->avg_cost;
                            $newAvgCost = $costingEngine->calculateAverageCost($product, $newQty, $newCost);
                            $warehouseStock->update([
                                'quantity' => $currentQty + $newQty,
                                'avg_cost' => $newAvgCost,
                            ]);
                        } else {
                            WarehouseStock::create([
                                'company_id' => $purchaseOrder->company_id,
                                'product_id' => $product->id,
                                'variant_id' => $variantId,
                                'quantity' => $newQty,
                                'avg_cost' => $newCost,
                            ]);
                        }
                        
                        $product->current_stock = $product->variants->sum('current_stock');
                        $product->save();
                    }
                } else {
                    $product->current_stock += $newQty;
                    $product->purchase_price = $newCost;
                    $product->save();
                    
                    $warehouseStock = WarehouseStock::where('product_id', $product->id)
                        ->whereNull('variant_id')
                        ->first();
                    
                    if ($warehouseStock) {
                        $currentQty = (float) $warehouseStock->quantity;
                        $currentCost = (float) $warehouseStock->avg_cost;
                        $newAvgCost = $costingEngine->calculateAverageCost($product, $newQty, $newCost);
                        $warehouseStock->update([
                            'quantity' => $currentQty + $newQty,
                            'avg_cost' => $newAvgCost,
                        ]);
                    } else {
                        WarehouseStock::create([
                            'company_id' => $purchaseOrder->company_id,
                            'product_id' => $product->id,
                            'quantity' => $newQty,
                            'avg_cost' => $newCost,
                        ]);
                    }
                }
                
                $avgCost = $costingEngine->getAverageCost($product, null);
                $product->update([
                    'last_purchase_date' => $purchaseOrder->date,
                    'purchase_price' => $avgCost,
                ]);
            }
        }
    }

                    'symbol' => $item->product->baseUnit->symbol,

            'success' => true,

    public function getReceiptsForReturn(Request $request): \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
    {
        $query = PurchaseReceipt::with(['supplier', 'purchaseOrder', 'items.product.baseUnit', 'items.variant'])

        if ($request->has('supplier_id')) {
            $query->where('supplier_id', $request->supplier_id);
        }

        $receipts = $query->orderBy('receipt_date', 'desc')->get();

        $result = $receipts->map(function ($receipt) {
            $items = $receipt->items->map(function ($item) {
                $returnable = (float) $item->received_quantity - (float) ($item->returned_qty ?? 0);
                return [
                    'id' => (string) $item->id,
                    'productId' => (string) $item->product_id,
                    'variantId' => $item->variant_id ? (string) $item->variant_id : null,
                    'productName' => $item->product?->name,
                    'variantName' => $item->variant?->name,
                    'sku' => $item->variant?->sku ?? $item->product?->sku,
                    'receivedQuantity' => (float) $item->received_quantity,
                    'returnedQty' => (float) ($item->returned_qty ?? 0),
                    'availableForReturn' => $returnable > 0 ? $returnable : 0,
                    'unitCost' => (float) $item->unit_cost,
                    'batchNumber' => $item->batch_number,
                    'expiryDate' => $item->expiry_date ? $item->expiry_date->format('Y-m-d') : null,

                        'name' => $item->product->baseUnit->name,
                        'symbol' => $item->product->baseUnit->symbol,
                    ] : null,
                ];
            })->filter(fn($item) => $item['availableForReturn'] > 0)->values();

            return [
                'id' => (string) $receipt->id,
                'grnNumber' => $receipt->grn_number,
                'purchaseOrderId' => (string) $receipt->purchase_order_id,
                'receiptDate' => $receipt->receipt_date->format('Y-m-d'),
                'totalQuantity' => (float) $receipt->total_quantity,
                'totalValue' => (float) $receipt->total_value,
                'status' => $receipt->status,
                'supplierId' => $receipt->supplier_id ? (string) $receipt->supplier_id : null,
                'supplierName' => $receipt->supplier?->name,
                'poNumber' => $receipt->purchaseOrder?->po_number,
                'items' => $items,
                'totalReturnableItems' => $items->count(),
            ];
        })->filter(fn($r) => $r['totalReturnableItems'] > 0)->values();

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $result]);
    }

    public function getReturnableBatches(PurchaseReceiptItem $purchaseReceiptItem): \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
    {
        $batches = StockEntry::where('product_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->product_id)
            ->when($purchaseReceiptItem->variant_id, fn($q) => $q->where('variant_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->variant_id))
            ->when($purchaseReceiptItem->warehouse_id, fn($q) => $q->where('warehouse_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->warehouse_id))
            ->whereIn('type', ['purchase', 'return_in', 'transfer_in', 'adjustment_positive'])
            ->whereRaw('(original_qty - COALESCE(quantity_consumed, 0)) > 0')
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('batch_id')
            ->map(function ($entries, $batchId) {
                $first = $entries->first();
                $totalRemaining = $entries->sum(fn($e) => (float) $e->original_qty - (float) ($e->quantity_consumed ?? 0));
                return [
                    'batch_id' => $batchId,
                    'batch_number' => $first->batch_number,
                    'available_qty' => $totalRemaining,
                    'expiry_date' => $first->expiry_date,
                    'cost_price' => (float) $first->cost_price,
                ];
            })
            ->values();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $batches,
        ]);
    }

    public function getReturnableSerials(PurchaseReceiptItem $purchaseReceiptItem): \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
    {
        $serialNumbers = $purchaseReceiptItem->serial_numbers
            ? json_decode($purchaseReceiptItem->serial_numbers, true)
            : [];

        if (empty($serialNumbers)) {
            return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
        }

        $serials = \App\Models\ProductSerial::whereIn('serial_number', $serialNumbers)
            ->where('product_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->product_id)
            ->when($purchaseReceiptItem->variant_id, fn($q) => $q->where('variant_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->variant_id))
            ->get()
            ->map(fn($s) => [
                'id' => (string) $s->id,
                'serial_number' => $s->serial_number,
                'imei1' => $s->imei1,
                'imei2' => $s->imei2,
                'status' => $s->status,
                'batch_id' => $s->batch_id,
            ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $serials,
        ]);
    }

            'items.*.variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'items.*.warehouse_id' => 'nullable|exists:warehouses,id',
            'items.*.location_id' => 'nullable|exists:locations,id',
            'items.*.ordered_quantity' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
            'items.*.received_quantity' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
            'items.*.unit_cost' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
            'items.*.batch_number' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'items.*.expiry_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'items.*.manufacture_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'items.*.qa_status' => 'nullable|in:pending,approved,rejected',
            'items.*.qa_notes' => 'nullable|string|max:500',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        if (isset($validated['items'])) {
            // Delete existing items
            $purchaseReceipt->items()->delete();

            $totalQuantity = 0;
            $totalValue = 0;

            foreach ($validated['items'] as $itemData) {
                $totalQuantity += $itemData['received_quantity'];
                $totalValue += $itemData['received_quantity'] * $itemData['unit_cost'];

                // Find corresponding PO item if exists
                $poItem = $purchaseReceipt->purchaseOrder->items()
                    ->where('product_id', $itemData['product_id'])
                    ->where('variant_id', $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null)
                    ->first();

                $totalCost = $itemData['received_quantity'] * $itemData['unit_cost'];

                PurchaseReceiptItem::create([
                    'purchase_receipt_id' => $purchaseReceipt->id,
                    'purchase_order_item_id' => $poItem?->id,
                    'product_id' => $itemData['product_id'],
                    'variant_id' => $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null,
                    'warehouse_id' => $itemData['warehouse_id'] ?? null,
                    'location_id' => $itemData['location_id'] ?? null,
                    'ordered_quantity' => $itemData['ordered_quantity'],
                    'received_quantity' => $itemData['received_quantity'],
                    'unit_cost' => $itemData['unit_cost'],
                    'total_cost' => $totalCost,
                    'batch_number' => $itemData['batch_number'] ?? null,
                    'expiry_date' => $itemData['expiry_date'] ?? null,
                    'manufacture_date' => $itemData['manufacture_date'] ?? null,
                    'notes' => $itemData['notes'] ?? null,
                ]);
            }

            $purchaseReceipt->total_quantity = $totalQuantity;
            $purchaseReceipt->total_value = $totalValue;
        }

        $purchaseReceipt->update($validated);

        return new PurchaseReceiptResource($purchaseReceipt->load(['supplier', 'items.product.baseUnit', 'items.variant', 'purchaseOrder']));
    }

    public function confirm(Request $request, PurchaseReceipt $purchaseReceipt)
    {
        try {
            // Load items before confirming
            $purchaseReceipt->load('items');
            
            // Enterprise: Check QA status if required
            $requiresQA = filter_var($request->header('X-Require-QA', false), FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN);
            if ($requiresQA) {
                $rejectedItems = $purchaseReceipt->items->filter(fn($item) => $item->qa_status === 'rejected');
                if ($rejectedItems->isNotEmpty()) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'success' => false,
                        'message' => 'Cannot confirm: ' . $rejectedItems->count() . ' item(s) rejected in QA',
                    ], 422);
                }
            }
            
            $purchaseReceipt->confirm();
            
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Purchase receipt confirmed and stock updated successfully',
                'data' => new PurchaseReceiptResource($purchaseReceipt->load(['supplier', 'items.product.baseUnit', 'items.variant', 'purchaseOrder']))
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => $e->getMessage(),
            ], 422);
        }
    }

    public function cancel(PurchaseReceipt $purchaseReceipt)
    {
        try {
            $purchaseReceipt->cancel();
            
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Purchase receipt cancelled successfully',
                'data' => new PurchaseReceiptResource($purchaseReceipt->load(['supplier', 'items.product.baseUnit', 'items.variant', 'purchaseOrder']))
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => $e->getMessage(),
            ], 422);
        }
    }

    public function destroy(PurchaseReceipt $purchaseReceipt)
    {
        if ($purchaseReceipt->status !== 'Draft') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Only draft receipts can be deleted',
            ], 422);
        }

        $purchaseReceipt->items()->delete();
        $purchaseReceipt->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Purchase receipt deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    public function getPurchaseOrderItems(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        // Get all confirmed receipts for this PO to calculate per-item received quantity
        $confirmedReceipts = $purchaseOrder->receipts()->where('status', 'Confirmed')->with('items')->get();
        
        // Calculate received quantity per product/variant
        $receivedQuantities = [];
        foreach ($confirmedReceipts as $receipt) {
            foreach ($receipt->items as $receiptItem) {
                $key = $receiptItem->product_id . '-' . ($receiptItem->variant_id ?? 'null');
                if (!isset($receivedQuantities[$key])) {
                    $receivedQuantities[$key] = 0;
                }
                $receivedQuantities[$key] += $receiptItem->received_quantity;
            }
        }

        $items = $purchaseOrder->items()->with(['product.baseUnit', 'variant'])->get()->map(function ($item) use ($receivedQuantities) {
            $key = $item->product_id . '-' . ($item->variant_id ?? 'null');
            $alreadyReceived = $receivedQuantities[$key] ?? 0;
            $remainingQuantity = max(0, $item->quantity - $alreadyReceived);
            
            return [
                'id' => $item->id,
                'product_id' => $item->product_id,
                'variant_id' => $item->variant_id,
                'product_name' => $item->product->name,
                'variant_name' => $item->variant?->name,
                'sku' => $item->variant?->sku ?? $item->product->sku,
                'barcode' => ProductBarcode::where('product_id', $item->product_id)
                    ->when($item->variant_id, fn ($query) => $query->where('variant_id', $item->variant_id), fn ($query) => $query->whereNull('variant_id'))
                    ->where('is_primary', true)
                    ->value('barcode'),
                'tracking_type' => $item->product->tracking_type,
                'ordered_quantity' => $item->quantity,
                'unit_cost' => $item->unit_cost,
                'base_unit' => $item->product->baseUnit ? [
                    'id' => (string) $item->product->baseUnit->id,
                    'name' => $item->product->baseUnit->name,
                    'symbol' => $item->product->baseUnit->symbol,
                ] : null,
                'remaining_quantity' => $remainingQuantity,
            ];
        });

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $items,
        ]);
    }

    public function getReceiptsForReturn(Request $request): \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
    {
        $query = PurchaseReceipt::with(['supplier', 'purchaseOrder', 'items.product.baseUnit', 'items.variant'])
            ->where('status', 'Confirmed');

        if ($request->has('supplier_id')) {
            $query->where('supplier_id', $request->supplier_id);
        }

        $receipts = $query->orderBy('receipt_date', 'desc')->get();

        $result = $receipts->map(function ($receipt) {
            $items = $receipt->items->map(function ($item) {
                $returnable = (float) $item->received_quantity - (float) ($item->returned_qty ?? 0);
                return [
                    'id' => (string) $item->id,
                    'productId' => (string) $item->product_id,
                    'variantId' => $item->variant_id ? (string) $item->variant_id : null,
                    'productName' => $item->product?->name,
                    'variantName' => $item->variant?->name,
                    'sku' => $item->variant?->sku ?? $item->product?->sku,
                    'receivedQuantity' => (float) $item->received_quantity,
                    'returnedQty' => (float) ($item->returned_qty ?? 0),
                    'availableForReturn' => $returnable > 0 ? $returnable : 0,
                    'unitCost' => (float) $item->unit_cost,
                    'batchNumber' => $item->batch_number,
                    'expiryDate' => $item->expiry_date ? $item->expiry_date->format('Y-m-d') : null,
                    'serialNumbers' => $item->serial_numbers ? json_decode($item->serial_numbers, true) : [],
                    'trackingType' => $item->product?->tracking_type ?? 'none',
                    'warehouseId' => $item->warehouse_id ? (string) $item->warehouse_id : null,
                    'locationId' => $item->location_id ? (string) $item->location_id : null,
                    'baseUnit' => $item->product?->baseUnit ? [
                        'id' => (string) $item->product->baseUnit->id,
                        'name' => $item->product->baseUnit->name,
                        'symbol' => $item->product->baseUnit->symbol,
                    ] : null,
                ];
            })->filter(fn($item) => $item['availableForReturn'] > 0)->values();

            return [
                'id' => (string) $receipt->id,
                'grnNumber' => $receipt->grn_number,
                'purchaseOrderId' => (string) $receipt->purchase_order_id,
                'receiptDate' => $receipt->receipt_date->format('Y-m-d'),
                'totalQuantity' => (float) $receipt->total_quantity,
                'totalValue' => (float) $receipt->total_value,
                'status' => $receipt->status,
                'supplierId' => $receipt->supplier_id ? (string) $receipt->supplier_id : null,
                'supplierName' => $receipt->supplier?->name,
                'poNumber' => $receipt->purchaseOrder?->po_number,
                'items' => $items,
                'totalReturnableItems' => $items->count(),
            ];
        })->filter(fn($r) => $r['totalReturnableItems'] > 0)->values();

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $result]);
    }

    public function getReturnableBatches(PurchaseReceiptItem $purchaseReceiptItem): \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
    {
        $batches = StockEntry::where('product_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->product_id)
            ->when($purchaseReceiptItem->variant_id, fn($q) => $q->where('variant_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->variant_id))
            ->when($purchaseReceiptItem->warehouse_id, fn($q) => $q->where('warehouse_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->warehouse_id))
            ->whereIn('type', ['purchase', 'return_in', 'transfer_in', 'adjustment_positive'])
            ->whereRaw('(original_qty - COALESCE(quantity_consumed, 0)) > 0')
            ->get()
            ->groupBy('batch_id')
            ->map(function ($entries, $batchId) {
                $first = $entries->first();
                $totalRemaining = $entries->sum(fn($e) => (float) $e->original_qty - (float) ($e->quantity_consumed ?? 0));
                return [
                    'batch_id' => $batchId,
                    'batch_number' => $first->batch_number,
                    'available_qty' => $totalRemaining,
                    'expiry_date' => $first->expiry_date,
                    'cost_price' => (float) $first->cost_price,
                ];
            })
            ->values();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $batches,
        ]);
    }

    public function getReturnableSerials(PurchaseReceiptItem $purchaseReceiptItem): \Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse
    {
        $serialNumbers = $purchaseReceiptItem->serial_numbers
            ? json_decode($purchaseReceiptItem->serial_numbers, true)
            : [];

        if (empty($serialNumbers)) {
            return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => []]);
        }

        $serials = \App\Models\ProductSerial::whereIn('serial_number', $serialNumbers)
            ->where('product_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->product_id)
            ->when($purchaseReceiptItem->variant_id, fn($q) => $q->where('variant_id', $purchaseReceiptItem->variant_id))
            ->get()
            ->map(fn($s) => [
                'id' => (string) $s->id,
                'serial_number' => $s->serial_number,
                'imei1' => $s->imei1,
                'imei2' => $s->imei2,
                'status' => $s->status,
                'batch_id' => $s->batch_id,
            ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $serials,
        ]);
    }
}

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Resources\ReturnResource;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ProductVariant;
use App\Models\ProductReturn;
use App\Models\ReturnItem;
use App\Models\Invoice;
use App\Models\Account;
use App\Models\AccountTransaction;
use App\Models\CreditNote;
use App\Models\CreditNoteItem;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\AnonymousResourceCollection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class ReturnController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        try {
            $query = ProductReturn::with(['invoice', 'returnItems', 'processedBy']);

            if ($request->has('status') && $request->status) {
                $query->where('status', $request->status);
            }

            if ($request->has('start_date') && $request->start_date) {
                $query->where('date', '>=', $request->start_date);
            }

            if ($request->has('end_date') && $request->end_date) {
                $query->where('date', '<=', $request->end_date);
            }

            if ($request->has('search') && $request->search) {
                $search = $request->search;
                $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                    $q->where('return_number', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                      ->orWhere('customer_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                      ->orWhere('customer_mobile', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                });
            }

            $returns = $query->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get();

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'data' => ReturnResource::collection($returns),
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('Error fetching returns: ' . $e->getMessage(), [
                'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString(),
            ]);
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        DB::beginTransaction();
        try {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'invoice_id' => 'required|exists:invoices,id',
                'date' => 'required|date',
                'time' => 'required|date_format:H:i:s',
                'customer_name' => 'required|string',
                'customer_mobile' => 'required|string',
                'reason' => 'nullable|string',
                'items' => 'required|array|min:1',
                'items.*.product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',
                'items.*.variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
                'items.*.name' => 'required|string',
                'items.*.quantity' => 'required|integer|min:1',
                'items.*.unit_price' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
                'items.*.total' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
                'items.*.reason' => 'nullable|string',
            ]);

            $invoice = Invoice::with('items')->findOrFail($validated['invoice_id']);
            
            $invoiceItems = $invoice->items->keyBy(function ($item) {
                return $item->product_id . '-' . ($item->variant_id ?? 'null');
            });
            
            foreach ($validated['items'] as $itemData) {
                $key = $itemData['product_id'] . '-' . ($itemData['variant_id'] ?? 'null');
                $invoiceItem = $invoiceItems->get($key);
                
                if (!$invoiceItem) {
                    throw new \Exception("Product '{$itemData['name']}' was not in the original invoice");
                }
                
                $soldQty = (float) $invoiceItem->quantity;
                $alreadyReturned = $this->getAlreadyReturnedQty($validated['invoice_id'], $itemData['product_id'], $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null);
                $maxReturnable = $soldQty - $alreadyReturned;
                
                if ($itemData['quantity'] > $maxReturnable) {
                    throw new \Exception("Cannot return {$itemData['quantity']} units of '{$itemData['name']}'. Only {$maxReturnable} units are returnable (sold: {$soldQty}, already returned: {$alreadyReturned})");
                }
            }

            do {
                $returnNumber = 'RTN-' . strtoupper(Str::random(8));
            } while (ProductReturn::where('return_number', $returnNumber)->exists());

            $validated['return_number'] = $returnNumber;
            $validated['total_refund'] = collect($validated['items'])->sum('total');

            $return = ProductReturn::create($validated);
            
            if (!$return || !isset($return->id)) {
                throw new \Exception('Failed to create return record');
            }

            foreach ($validated['items'] as $itemData) {
                $returnItem = ReturnItem::create([
                    'return_id' => $return->id,
                    'product_id' => $itemData['product_id'],
                    'variant_id' => $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null,
                    'name' => $itemData['name'],
                    'quantity' => $itemData['quantity'],
                    'unit_price' => $itemData['unit_price'],
                    'total' => $itemData['total'],
                    'reason' => $itemData['reason'] ?? null,
                ]);

                if (!$returnItem) {
                    throw new \Exception('Failed to create return item');
                }
            }

            $return->refresh();
            try {
                $return->load(['invoice', 'returnItems']);
            } catch (\Exception $e) {
                Log::warning('Error loading return relationships: ' . $e->getMessage());
            }
            
            DB::commit();
            
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'data' => new ReturnResource($return),
            ]);
        } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Validation failed',
                'errors' => $e->errors(),
            ], 422);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            DB::rollBack();
            Log::error('Error creating return: ' . $e->getMessage(), [
                'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString(),
                'request' => $request->all(),
            ]);
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create return: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ], 500);
        }
    }
    
    private function getAlreadyReturnedQty(int $invoiceId, int $productId, ?int $variantId): float
    {
        $approvedReturns = ProductReturn::where('invoice_id', $invoiceId)
            ->whereIn('status', ['Pending', 'Approved'])
            ->with('returnItems')
            ->get();
            
        $totalReturned = 0;
        foreach ($approvedReturns as $return) {
            foreach ($return->returnItems as $item) {
                if ($item->product_id == $productId && $item->variant_id == $variantId) {
                    $totalReturned += $item->quantity;
                }
            }
        }
        return $totalReturned;
    }

    public function show($returnModel)
    {
        try {
            $return = ProductReturn::with(['invoice', 'returnItems', 'processedBy'])->findOrFail($returnModel);
            return new ReturnResource($return);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('Error fetching return: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Return not found',
            ], 404);
        }
    }

    public function update(Request $request, $returnModel)
    {
        $return = ProductReturn::with(['returnItems', 'invoice'])->findOrFail($returnModel);
        
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'status' => 'sometimes|in:Pending,Approved,Rejected',
            'reason' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        if (isset($validated['status']) && $validated['status'] !== $return->status) {
            $validated['processed_by'] = $request->user()->id;
            $validated['processed_at'] = now();

            if ($validated['status'] === 'Rejected' && $return->status === 'Approved') {
                foreach ($return->returnItems as $item) {
                    $this->unrestockItem($item->toArray());
                }
                $this->removeReturnAccountingEntries($return);
                $this->updateInvoiceStatus($return);
            }

            if ($validated['status'] === 'Approved' && $return->status === 'Pending') {
                foreach ($return->returnItems as $item) {
                    $this->restockItem($item->toArray());
                }
                $this->postReturnAccountingEntries($return);
                $this->updateInvoiceStatus($return);
                $this->createCreditNote($return);
            }
        }

        $return->update($validated);

        return new ReturnResource($return->load(['invoice', 'returnItems', 'processedBy']));
    }
    
    private function postReturnAccountingEntries(ProductReturn $return): void
    {
        $invoice = $return->invoice;
        if (!$invoice) {
            $invoice = Invoice::find($return->invoice_id);
        }
        
        $salesReturnsAccount = Account::where('code', '4200')->first();
        $inventoryAccount = Account::where('code', '1140')->first();
        $arAccount = Account::where('code', '1130')->first();
        
        if (!$salesReturnsAccount || !$inventoryAccount || !$arAccount) {
            Log::warning('Required accounts not found for return entries');
            return;
        }
        
        $refundAmount = $return->total_refund;
        $returnDate = $return->date ?? date('Y-m-d');
        
        $exists = AccountTransaction::where('reference_type', ProductReturn::class)
            ->where('reference_id', $return->id)
            ->exists();
            
        if ($exists) return;
        
        $totalCost = 0;
        foreach ($return->returnItems as $item) {
            $variantId = $item->variant_id;
            $costPrice = 0;
            
            if ($variantId) {
                $variant = ProductVariant::find($variantId);
                $costPrice = $variant?->purchase_price ?? 0;
            }
            
            if (!$costPrice) {
                $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
                $costPrice = $product?->purchase_price ?? 0;
            }
            
            $totalCost += $costPrice * $item->quantity;
        }
        
        $companyId = $invoice?->company_id ?? 1;
        
        $subTotal = (float) ($invoice->sub_total ?? 0);
        $grandTotal = (float) ($invoice->grand_total ?? 0);
        $totalTax = $grandTotal - $subTotal;
        $returnSubTotal = (float) $return->total_refund;
        $taxRatio = $subTotal > 0 ? $returnSubTotal / $subTotal : 0;
        $gstReversalAmount = $totalTax * $taxRatio;
        
        Log::info("GST Reversal Debug", [
            'invoice_id' => $invoice?->id,
            'sub_total' => $subTotal,
            'grand_total' => $grandTotal,
            'total_tax' => $totalTax,
            'return_amount' => $returnSubTotal,
            'tax_ratio' => $taxRatio,
            'gst_reversal' => $gstReversalAmount
        ]);
        
        AccountTransaction::create([
            'company_id' => $companyId,
            'date' => $returnDate,
            'debit_account_id' => $salesReturnsAccount->id,
            'credit_account_id' => $arAccount->id,
            'amount' => $returnSubTotal,
            'reference_type' => ProductReturn::class,
            'reference_id' => $return->id,
            'description' => "Sales Return - Invoice #{$invoice->invoice_number}",
        ]);
        
        if ($gstReversalAmount > 0) {
            $cgstAccount = Account::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('code', '2211')->first();
            $sgstAccount = Account::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('code', '2212')->first();
            
            if ($cgstAccount) {
                AccountTransaction::create([
                    'company_id' => $companyId,
                    'date' => $returnDate,
                    'debit_account_id' => $cgstAccount->id,
                    'credit_account_id' => $arAccount->id,
                    'amount' => $gstReversalAmount / 2,
                    'reference_type' => ProductReturn::class,
                    'reference_id' => $return->id,
                    'description' => "CGST Reversal - Return #{$return->return_number}",
                ]);
            }
            
            if ($sgstAccount) {
                AccountTransaction::create([
                    'company_id' => $companyId,
                    'date' => $returnDate,
                    'debit_account_id' => $sgstAccount->id,
                    'credit_account_id' => $arAccount->id,
                    'amount' => $gstReversalAmount / 2,
                    'reference_type' => ProductReturn::class,
                    'reference_id' => $return->id,
                    'description' => "SGST Reversal - Return #{$return->return_number}",
                ]);
            }
        }
        
        if ($totalCost > 0) {
            AccountTransaction::create([
                'company_id' => $companyId,
                'date' => $returnDate,
                'debit_account_id' => $inventoryAccount->id,
                'credit_account_id' => $salesReturnsAccount->id,
                'amount' => $totalCost,
                'reference_type' => ProductReturn::class,
                'reference_id' => $return->id,
                'description' => "Return COGS - Invoice #{$invoice->invoice_number}",
            ]);
        }
    }
    
    private function removeReturnAccountingEntries(ProductReturn $return): void
    {
        AccountTransaction::where('reference_type', ProductReturn::class)
            ->where('reference_id', $return->id)
            ->delete();
    }
    
    private function updateInvoiceStatus(ProductReturn $return): void
    {
        $invoice = $return->invoice;
        if (!$invoice) {
            $invoice = Invoice::find($return->invoice_id);
        }
        if (!$invoice) return;
        
        $allReturns = ProductReturn::where('invoice_id', $invoice->id)
            ->whereIn('status', ['Pending', 'Approved'])
            ->with('returnItems')
            ->get();
            
        $totalReturnedValue = 0;
        $totalInvoiceItems = $invoice->items->sum('total');
        
        foreach ($allReturns as $ret) {
            $totalReturnedValue += $ret->total_refund;
        }
        
        $effectiveRevenue = $totalInvoiceItems - $totalReturnedValue;
        
        if ($effectiveRevenue <= 0) {
            $invoice->payment_status = 'Returned';
            $invoice->balance_due = 0;
        } elseif ($totalReturnedValue > 0) {
            $invoice->payment_status = 'Partially Returned';
            $newBalance = $effectiveRevenue - $invoice->amount_received;
            $invoice->balance_due = max(0, $newBalance);
        }
        
        $invoice->save();
    }
    
    private function createCreditNote(ProductReturn $return): void
    {
        $invoice = $return->invoice;
        if (!$invoice) {
            $invoice = Invoice::find($return->invoice_id);
        }
        
        $exists = CreditNote::where('return_id', $return->id)->exists();
        if ($exists) return;
        
        $creditNoteNumber = 'CN-' . strtoupper(Str::random(8));
        while (CreditNote::where('credit_note_number', $creditNoteNumber)->exists()) {
            $creditNoteNumber = 'CN-' . strtoupper(Str::random(8));
        }
        
        $customerId = $invoice?->customer_id;
        $customerName = $return->customer_name;
        $customerMobile = $return->customer_mobile;
        
        $creditNote = CreditNote::create([
            'return_id' => $return->id,
            'credit_note_number' => $creditNoteNumber,
            'invoice_id' => $return->invoice_id,
            'customer_id' => $customerId,
            'customer_name' => $customerName,
            'customer_mobile' => $customerMobile,
            'total_amount' => $return->total_refund,
            'reason' => $return->reason,
            'status' => 'Issued',
            'created_by' => auth()->id(),
        ]);
        
        foreach ($return->returnItems as $item) {
            CreditNoteItem::create([
                'credit_note_id' => $creditNote->id,
                'product_id' => $item->product_id,
                'variant_id' => $item->variant_id,
                'name' => $item->name,
                'quantity' => $item->quantity,
                'unit_price' => $item->unit_price,
                'total' => $item->total,
            ]);
        }
        
        if ($customerId) {
            $customer = \App\Models\Customer::find($customerId);
            if ($customer) {
                $customer->credit_balance += $return->total_refund;
                $customer->save();
            }
        }
        
        Log::info("Credit note created for return {$return->return_number}: {$creditNoteNumber}");
    }
    
    public function destroy($returnModel)
    {
        $return = ProductReturn::with(['returnItems'])->findOrFail($returnModel);
        
        // If return was approved, remove the restocked items
        if ($return->status === 'Approved') {
            foreach ($return->returnItems as $item) {
                $this->unrestockItem($item->toArray());
            }
        }

        $return->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Return deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    private function restockItem(array $itemData): void
    {
        $product = Product::find($itemData['product_id'] ?? null);
        if ($product) {
            $variantId = $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null;
            if ($variantId) {
                $variant = ProductVariant::find($variantId);
                if ($variant) {
                    $variant->current_stock += ($itemData['quantity'] ?? 0);
                    $variant->save();
                    // Recalculate product stock
                    $product->current_stock = ProductVariant::where('product_id', $product->id)->sum('current_stock');
                    $product->save();
                }
            } else {
                $product->current_stock += ($itemData['quantity'] ?? 0);
                $product->save();
            }
        }
    }

    private function unrestockItem(array $itemData): void
    {
        $product = Product::find($itemData['product_id'] ?? null);
        if ($product) {
            $variantId = $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null;
            $quantity = $itemData['quantity'] ?? 0;
            
            if ($variantId) {
                $variant = ProductVariant::find($variantId);
                if ($variant && $variant->current_stock >= $quantity) {
                    $variant->current_stock -= $quantity;
                    $variant->save();
                    // Recalculate product stock
                    $product->current_stock = ProductVariant::where('product_id', $product->id)->sum('current_stock');
                    $product->save();
                }
            } else {
                if ($product->current_stock >= $quantity) {
                    $product->current_stock -= $quantity;
                    $product->save();
                }
            }
        }
    }

                    $this->restockItem($item->toArray());
                }
                $this->postReturnAccountingEntries($return);
                $this->updateInvoiceStatus($return);
                $this->createCreditNote($return);
            }
        }

        $return->update($validated);

        return new ReturnResource($return->load(['invoice', 'returnItems', 'processedBy']));
    }
    
    private function postReturnAccountingEntries(ProductReturn $return): void
    {
        $invoice = $return->invoice;
        if (!$invoice) {
            $invoice = Invoice::find($return->invoice_id);
        }
        
        $salesReturnsAccount = Account::where('code', '4200')->first();
        $inventoryAccount = Account::where('code', '1140')->first();
        $arAccount = Account::where('code', '1130')->first();
        
        if (!$salesReturnsAccount || !$inventoryAccount || !$arAccount) {
            Log::warning('Required accounts not found for return entries');
            return;
        }
        
        $refundAmount = $return->total_refund;
        $returnDate = $return->date ?? date('Y-m-d');
        
        $exists = AccountTransaction::where('reference_type', ProductReturn::class)
            ->where('reference_id', $return->id)
            ->exists();
            
        if ($exists) return;
        
        $totalCost = 0;
        foreach ($return->returnItems as $item) {
            $variantId = $item->variant_id;
            $costPrice = 0;
            
            if ($variantId) {
                $variant = ProductVariant::find($variantId);
                $costPrice = $variant?->purchase_price ?? 0;
            }
            
            if (!$costPrice) {
                $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
                $costPrice = $product?->purchase_price ?? 0;
            }
            
            $totalCost += $costPrice * $item->quantity;
        }
        
        $companyId = $invoice?->company_id 
            ?? auth()->user()->company_id 
            ?? throw new \Exception('Company not found for this return');
        
        $subTotal = (float) ($invoice->sub_total ?? 0);
        $grandTotal = (float) ($invoice->grand_total ?? 0);
        $totalTax = $grandTotal - $subTotal;
        $returnSubTotal = (float) $return->total_refund;
        $taxRatio = $subTotal > 0 ? $returnSubTotal / $subTotal : 0;
        $gstReversalAmount = $totalTax * $taxRatio;
        
        Log::info("GST Reversal Debug", [
            'invoice_id' => $invoice?->id,
            'sub_total' => $subTotal,
            'grand_total' => $grandTotal,
            'total_tax' => $totalTax,
            'return_amount' => $returnSubTotal,
            'tax_ratio' => $taxRatio,
            'gst_reversal' => $gstReversalAmount
        ]);
        
        AccountTransaction::create([
            'company_id' => $companyId,
            'date' => $returnDate,
            'debit_account_id' => $salesReturnsAccount->id,
            'credit_account_id' => $arAccount->id,
            'amount' => $returnSubTotal,
            'reference_type' => ProductReturn::class,
            'reference_id' => $return->id,
            'description' => "Sales Return - Invoice #{$invoice->invoice_number}",
        ]);
        
        if ($gstReversalAmount > 0) {
            $cgstAccount = Account::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('code', '2211')->first();
            $sgstAccount = Account::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('code', '2212')->first();
            
            if ($cgstAccount) {
                AccountTransaction::create([
                    'company_id' => $companyId,
                    'date' => $returnDate,
                    'debit_account_id' => $cgstAccount->id,
                    'credit_account_id' => $arAccount->id,
                    'amount' => $gstReversalAmount / 2,
                    'reference_type' => ProductReturn::class,
                    'reference_id' => $return->id,
                    'description' => "CGST Reversal - Return #{$return->return_number}",
                ]);
            }
            
            if ($sgstAccount) {
                AccountTransaction::create([
                    'company_id' => $companyId,
                    'date' => $returnDate,
                    'debit_account_id' => $sgstAccount->id,
                    'credit_account_id' => $arAccount->id,
                    'amount' => $gstReversalAmount / 2,
                    'reference_type' => ProductReturn::class,
                    'reference_id' => $return->id,
                    'description' => "SGST Reversal - Return #{$return->return_number}",
                ]);
            }
        }
        
        if ($totalCost > 0) {
            AccountTransaction::create([
                'company_id' => $companyId,
                'date' => $returnDate,
                'debit_account_id' => $inventoryAccount->id,
                'credit_account_id' => $salesReturnsAccount->id,
                'amount' => $totalCost,
                'reference_type' => ProductReturn::class,
                'reference_id' => $return->id,
                'description' => "Return COGS - Invoice #{$invoice->invoice_number}",
            ]);
        }
    }
    
    private function removeReturnAccountingEntries(ProductReturn $return): void
    {
        AccountTransaction::where('reference_type', ProductReturn::class)
            ->where('reference_id', $return->id)
            ->delete();
    }
    
    private function updateInvoiceStatus(ProductReturn $return): void
    {
        $invoice = $return->invoice;
        if (!$invoice) {
            $invoice = Invoice::find($return->invoice_id);
        }
        if (!$invoice) return;
        
        $allReturns = ProductReturn::where('invoice_id', $invoice->id)
            ->whereIn('status', ['Pending', 'Approved'])
            ->with('returnItems')
            ->get();
            
        $totalReturnedValue = 0;
        $totalInvoiceItems = $invoice->items->sum('total');
        
        foreach ($allReturns as $ret) {
            $totalReturnedValue += $ret->total_refund;
        }
        
        $effectiveRevenue = $totalInvoiceItems - $totalReturnedValue;
        
        if ($effectiveRevenue <= 0) {
            $invoice->payment_status = 'Returned';
            $invoice->balance_due = 0;
        } elseif ($totalReturnedValue > 0) {
            $invoice->payment_status = 'Partially Returned';
            $newBalance = $effectiveRevenue - $invoice->amount_received;
            $invoice->balance_due = max(0, $newBalance);
        }
        
        $invoice->save();
    }
    
    private function createCreditNote(ProductReturn $return): void
    {
        $invoice = $return->invoice;
        if (!$invoice) {
            $invoice = Invoice::find($return->invoice_id);
        }
        
        $exists = CreditNote::where('return_id', $return->id)->exists();
        if ($exists) return;
        
        $creditNoteNumber = 'CN-' . strtoupper(Str::random(8));
        while (CreditNote::where('credit_note_number', $creditNoteNumber)->exists()) {
            $creditNoteNumber = 'CN-' . strtoupper(Str::random(8));
        }
        
        $customerId = $invoice?->customer_id;
        $customerName = $return->customer_name;
        $customerMobile = $return->customer_mobile;
        
        $creditNote = CreditNote::create([
            'return_id' => $return->id,
            'credit_note_number' => $creditNoteNumber,
            'invoice_id' => $return->invoice_id,
            'customer_id' => $customerId,
            'customer_name' => $customerName,
            'customer_mobile' => $customerMobile,
            'total_amount' => $return->total_refund,
            'reason' => $return->reason,
            'status' => 'Issued',
            'created_by' => auth()->id(),
        ]);
        
        foreach ($return->returnItems as $item) {
            CreditNoteItem::create([
                'credit_note_id' => $creditNote->id,
                'product_id' => $item->product_id,
                'variant_id' => $item->variant_id,
                'name' => $item->name,
                'quantity' => $item->quantity,
                'unit_price' => $item->unit_price,
                'total' => $item->total,
            ]);
        }
        
        if ($customerId) {
            $customer = \App\Models\Customer::find($customerId);
            if ($customer) {
                $customer->credit_balance += $return->total_refund;
                $customer->save();
            }
        }
        
        Log::info("Credit note created for return {$return->return_number}: {$creditNoteNumber}");
    }
    
    public function destroy($returnModel)
    {
        $return = ProductReturn::with(['returnItems'])->findOrFail($returnModel);
        
        // If return was approved, remove the restocked items
        if ($return->status === 'Approved') {
            foreach ($return->returnItems as $item) {
                $this->unrestockItem($item->toArray());
            }
        }

        $return->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Return deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    private function restockItem(array $itemData): void
    {
        $product = Product::find($itemData['product_id'] ?? null);
        if ($product) {
            $variantId = $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null;
            if ($variantId) {
                $variant = ProductVariant::find($variantId);
                if ($variant) {
                    $variant->current_stock += ($itemData['quantity'] ?? 0);
                    $variant->save();
                    // Recalculate product stock
                    $product->current_stock = ProductVariant::where('product_id', $product->id)->sum('current_stock');
                    $product->save();
                }
            } else {
                $product->current_stock += ($itemData['quantity'] ?? 0);
                $product->save();
            }
        }
    }

    private function unrestockItem(array $itemData): void
    {
        $product = Product::find($itemData['product_id'] ?? null);
        if ($product) {
            $variantId = $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null;
            $quantity = $itemData['quantity'] ?? 0;
            
            if ($variantId) {
                $variant = ProductVariant::find($variantId);
                if ($variant && $variant->current_stock >= $quantity) {
                    $variant->current_stock -= $quantity;
                    $variant->save();
                    // Recalculate product stock
                    $product->current_stock = ProductVariant::where('product_id', $product->id)->sum('current_stock');
                    $product->save();
                }
            } else {
                if ($product->current_stock >= $quantity) {
                    $product->current_stock -= $quantity;
                    $product->save();
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            'address' => 'nullable|string',

        if (isset($validated['is_default']) && $validated['is_default']) {

    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => 'sometimes|string|max:255',
            'code' => 'sometimes|string|max:20|unique:warehouses,code,' . $warehouse->id,
            'address' => 'nullable|string',
            'is_default' => 'boolean',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
        ]);

        // If setting as default, unset others
        if (isset($validated['is_default']) && $validated['is_default']) {
            Warehouse::where('is_default', true)->where('id', '!=', $warehouse->id)->update(['is_default' => false]);

                'message' => 'Cannot delete default warehouse',
            ], Response::HTTPunprocessable_ENTITY);

            'data' => $stock,

            'to_warehouse_id' => 'required|exists:warehouses,id|different:from_warehouse_id',

            $sourceStock->save();

                'warehouse_id' => $validated['from_warehouse_id'],

                'quantity' => -$validated['quantity'],
                'direction' => 'out',
                'reason' => 'transfer',
                'notes' => $validated['notes'] ?? null,
            ]);

            // Increase target stock
            $targetStock = WarehouseStock::firstOrCreate(
                [
                    'product_id' => $validated['product_id'],
                    'variant_id' => $validated['variant_id'] ?? null,
                    'warehouse_id' => $validated['to_warehouse_id'],
                ],
                [
                    'quantity' => 0,
                    'avg_cost' => $sourceStock->avg_cost ?? 0,
                ]
            );

            $targetStock->save();

                'warehouse_id' => $validated['to_warehouse_id'],

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ProductCodeSequence;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\Company;

class AlignProductCodeSequenceSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        // Align per-company product code sequences with existing items to avoid duplicates
        $companies = Company::all();
        foreach ($companies as $company) {
            // Resolve prefix/padding for this company
            $prefix = Setting::where('company_id', $company->id)
                        ->where('key', 'item_code_prefix')
                        ->value('value');
            $prefix = $prefix ?? 'ITEM';

            $padding = Setting::where('company_id', $company->id)
                        ->where('key', 'item_code_padding')
                        ->value('value');
            $padding = (int)($padding ?? 3);

            // Determine max numeric suffix used in this company's products
            $max = Product::where('company_id', $company->id)
                ->where('item_code', 'like', $prefix . '%')
                ->get()
                ->map(function ($p) use ($prefix) {
                    $code = $p->item_code;
                    // Case-insensitive match for prefix
                    if (preg_match('/^' . preg_quote($prefix, '/') . '(\d+)$/i', $code, $m)) {
                        return (int)$m[1];
                    }
                    return null;
                })
                ->filter()
                ->max();

            $max = $max ?? 0;

            // Ensure a sequence row exists for this company and set last_number accordingly
            $seq = ProductCodeSequence::firstOrCreate(
                ['company_id' => $company->id],
                ['prefix' => $prefix, 'padding' => $padding, 'last_number' => 0]
            );
            if ($max > $seq->last_number) {
                $seq->last_number = $max;
                $seq->save();
                $this->command->info("Aligned product_code_sequences for company {$company->id} to last_number {$max}");
            } else {
                $this->command->info("No alignment needed for company {$company->id}");
            }
        }
    }
}
